breve: GLTFTexture represents a texture in a glTF file.

propriedades.desc: ID of the texture sampler to use when sampling the image. If -1, then the default texture sampler is used (linear filtering, and repeat wrapping in both axes).
The index of the image associated with this texture, see 'GLTFState.get_images'. If -1, then this texture does not have an image assigned.
